rescue_vol_enabled.description: Enable automatic mounting of the rescue volume at boot time.

rescue_vol_device.description: Block device path or persistent identifier (e.g., UUID, label) of the rescue volume.

rescue_vol_path.description: Mount point directory where the rescue volume will be mounted.

rescue_vol_fstype.description: Filesystem type of the rescue volume (e.g., ext4, xfs, vfat).

rescue_vol_mount_opts.description: Additional mount options (e.g., '-o ro,noatime'). Use empty string for default options.

rescue_vol_post_mount_steps.description: List of optional post-mount actions to perform after successfully mounting the rescue volume.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this post-mount step.

description.description: Brief human-readable explanation of what this step does.

cmd.description: Shell command (or commands, separated by semicolons) to run during this step.
